# ClassReImplementsParentInterface

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Architecture](/rules/#architecture) · PhpStorm name: `ClassReImplementsParentInterfaceInspection`

Listing an interface in `implements` when the parent class already implements
it (directly or through its own ancestors) is redundant noise. Remove the
entry.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{12,14,16} [Before]
<?php
namespace Store {
    use Countable as Sized;

    interface Readable {}
    interface Seekable extends Readable {}
    abstract class Stream implements Readable {}
    abstract class FileStream implements Seekable, \Countable {}

    class Socket extends Stream
        implements
            Readable {}

    class Disk extends FileStream implements Readable, Sized {}

    class Tape extends FileStream implements \JsonSerializable, Seekable {
        public function jsonSerialize(): mixed { return null; }
        public function count(): int { return 0; }
    }

    class Pipe extends Stream implements Seekable {}
    class Loose implements Readable, Seekable {}
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
namespace Store {
    use Countable as Sized;

    interface Readable {}
    interface Seekable extends Readable {}
    abstract class Stream implements Readable {}
    abstract class FileStream implements Seekable, \Countable {}

    class Socket extends Stream
        {}

    class Disk extends FileStream {}

    class Tape extends FileStream implements \JsonSerializable {
        public function jsonSerialize(): mixed { return null; }
        public function count(): int { return 0; }
    }

    class Pipe extends Stream implements Seekable {}
    class Loose implements Readable, Seekable {}
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 12: &#39;\Store\Readable&#39; is already implemented by &#39;\Store\Stream&#39;; remove it here.</li>
<li>line 14: &#39;\Store\Readable&#39; is already implemented by &#39;\Store\FileStream&#39;; remove it here.</li>
<li>line 14: &#39;\Countable&#39; is already implemented by &#39;\Store\FileStream&#39;; remove it here.</li>
<li>line 16: &#39;\Store\Seekable&#39; is already implemented by &#39;\Store\FileStream&#39;; remove it here.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ClassReImplementsParentInterface": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore ClassReImplementsParentInterface

/**
 * @noinspection ClassReImplementsParentInterfaceInspection
 */
```
